column1: # 0.19.6's identifier renames, old<TAB>new, oldest first (0.19.6 A-44). gcprobe's tree test applies
# every line to the compiler's baselines' keys, in order, to each field where the old name stands
# whole, and only to the keys of the package an optional third field names (A-49); the scoped sweep
# reads it as SCOPED_FUNCS, a mutant's enclosing function by exact name, in that package. A batch
# that renames a function adds its lines in the renaming commit.
# B1 (0.19.6 D-48): MasterControl's dip is duck, the word of the call below it
# B2 (design CK-1): the kit's names exported in place, each scoped to modes/tty's keys, a method before its type so each line still finds its text
# B3 (design CK-2): the console's names exported in place, each scoped to modes/tty's keys; a method by its receiver, so the Dashboard's heldCursor keeps its name

# B4.3 (design MS-1, D-76, D-80): the map's 387 methods re-homed onto its model, each scoped to modes/tty's keys; the five window keys' and the open's under the model's own names, their Dashboard adapters new (observer_map.go)

# B4.3 (design MS-2, K-8): the bodies the Dashboard and the map now share, one owner each, the Dashboard's method calling it; none was inlined anywhere at baseline but numPriority, which its wrapper still inlines, and mapCeiling and mapWindowCols, whose callers call their bodies' functions; the selection's under the names that keep the two apart (P10-01)
# B4.3 (D-80): the receiver's text in a value the compiler names by its source
# B4.3 (D-82): rain-is-radar asks the mode it is handed, decided once by its caller
